authority: City of St. Louis Housing Authority (SLHA)

2027.label: 2027 (projected)
2027.note: Provisional: the city/county had not published official 2027 payment standards as of the build date. These are HUD's FY2027 Small Area FMRs, which the authority has historically adopted within ~0-2%. The 5-bedroom figure is derived as 1.15x the 4-bedroom, per HUD's own formula.
